ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The bottom of the figure is labeled “Phytoplankton,” the middle is labeled “Krill,” and the top is “Baleen whale.” The arrow points upward from Phytoplankton to Krill, and then from Krill upward to Baleen whale. Reasoning: A primary consumer is an organism that directly eats producers. Phytoplankton is the producer, and the one directly above it in the figure and connected by the arrow is Krill, so the primary consumer is krill.
